title: Isosativan from Nigerian propolis: investigation of mTORC2/AKT signaling and muscle atrophy genes in a diabetic rat model
core_idea: To investigate whether isosativan derived from Nigerian propolis influences the mTORC2/AKT signaling pathway and the expression of muscle atrophy genes (atrogin-1 and MuRF1) in a high-fat diet/low-dose streptozotocin-induced diabetic rat model, and to assess related effects on muscle atrophy and body weight.
tldr: Study tests whether isosativan modulates mTORC2/AKT signaling and atrogin-1/MuRF1 expression in diabetic rats to evaluate its potential impact on diabetic muscle atrophy.
